name: Kind of work, then tool (with hand-off)
description: The decision ladder of add-decision-patterns: the kind of work, then only the tools for that kind. A kind with one tool (run, remote: Bash; browse: the browser; ask: AskUserQuestion) goes straight to DONE; its entry in the options map is never used, and exists because check() needs an entry for every answer. A fan-out question asks, in the same pass, whether the next calls can run together. Below 0.4 confidence, the decision goes to the large model.

kind.instructions: What kind of work will the coding agent do next?

criteria.inspect: Read or search without changing anything
criteria.change: Change local files or local app data
criteria.run: Run a program, tests or a build
criteria.remote: Act on a remote machine or cloud service
criteria.publish: Make something visible to other people
criteria.orchestrate: Manage its own work: agents, skills, tool search, monitors

fanout.instructions: Can the next calls run together, in one message?

tool.instructions: Which tool will the coding agent use for this work?

inspect.mcp: A tool of a connected service

change.mcp: A tool of a connected service

research.mcp: A tool of a connected service

publish.mcp: A tool of a connected service
publish.SendUserFile: Send a file to the user
